    2: {"processing_time": 61, "due_date": 276, "weight": 6},

}

model.Params.OutputFlag = 0

# Number of jobs
n = len(jobs)

T = model.addVars(n, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="T")  # Tardiness
x = model.addVars(n, n, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="x")   # Sequencing variables

# Constraints

for j in range(n):

    model.addConstr(T[j] >= C[j] - jobs[j]["due_date"])

# Sequencing constraints
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        if i != j:
            model.addConstr(C[i] + (jobs[j]["processing_time"] * x[i, j]) <= C[j] + (1 - x[i, j]) * sum(jobs[k]["processing_time"] for k in range(n)))

for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        if x[i, j].X > 0.5:
            sequence.append(j)
            break

# Calculate the objective value
objective_value = model.ObjVal

# Output the result
